overviewDescription: A general picture of what usually goes into this kind of work. The final scope is always agreed with you before anything starts.
requestablesEyebrow: Ask for exactly what you need
requestablesDescription: There's no fixed package here — you ask for whatever makes sense for your setup. Some examples of what we've already handled:

montagem-de-setups.title: Custom Builds
montagem-de-setups.lead: Setups built from scratch with the best parts for your profile and budget.
montagem-de-setups.description: Every build starts with a conversation: what you'll use the PC for, your budget, and what can't be missing. From there we choose the parts, build with real cable management, and only deliver after running stability and temperature tests.

highlights.title: No-nonsense consultation
highlights.text: Parts chosen for your real use, not to push what's left in stock.

highlights.title: Real cable management
highlights.text: Airflow and looks aligned, no loose wiring inside the case.

highlights.title: Tested before it leaves the bench
highlights.text: CPU and GPU stress tests, temperature checks and validation before delivery.

requestables: Transport and delivery to your address

reforma-e-upgrade.title: Upgrades & Overhauls
reforma-e-upgrade.lead: We upgrade your current setup to make it faster, more powerful and more modern.
reforma-e-upgrade.description: Before swapping any part, we analyze what your current setup actually needs. The upgrade targets whatever's holding back performance (memory, SSD, cooling or graphics card), with a full cleanup and benchmark validation at the end.

highlights.title: Honest diagnosis
highlights.text: We tell you what's actually worth replacing, without pushing parts you don't need.

highlights.title: Making the most of what already works
highlights.text: We only replace what's holding back your setup's performance.

highlights.title: Before-and-after comparison
highlights.text: Real benchmarks so you can see the performance gain in practice.

personalizacao.title: Customization
personalizacao.lead: We turn your setup into an extension of your identity, with looks and RGB.
personalizacao.description: Color, lighting and theme are decided together with you before any part is moved. We work with made-to-measure sleeved cables, decals, wraps and custom water cooling to make the setup look exactly like the one in your head.

highlights.title: Made-to-measure project
highlights.text: Colors, lighting and theme planned with you before any part is swapped.

highlights.title: Finishing that impresses
highlights.text: Sleeved cables, invisible routing and custom sleeving.

highlights.title: Water cooling without shortcuts
highlights.text: Safe assembly and maintenance of custom loops.

suporte-tecnico.title: Technical Support
suporte-tecnico.lead: No customer forgotten. We're always here to sort it out.
suporte-tecnico.description: After-sales doesn't end at delivery. Whether it's a remote diagnosis, a system reinstall or an on-site visit, you talk directly to whoever built your PC, no call center, no script.

highlights.title: Direct support from whoever built it
highlights.text: No call center and no script, you talk to whoever knows your setup.

highlights.title: In person or remote
highlights.text: We solve what can be handled remotely, and come to you when it's needed.

highlights.title: Lifetime after-sales support
highlights.text: A question or a problem after delivery, you always have someone to help.
